Source/process/identity/node/evidence navigation lens. Proposed view label; not a separate canonical method

Read-only synchronized structural/process projection in W34; no claimed live autonomous workflow or plant-control feedback

Embed Plotly once or store local plotly.min.js; never silently require CDN in release offline view
Static PNG/SVG with pinned semantic source payload and hash; not a substituted native run
Visual debt bar constrained to ONE source-owned numerator and denominator, including explicit historical/unknown qualification. Not a merge or native runtime status.
Clickable typed list of canonical placements in one owner lane or multiple touching DAGs. Drawn purple regions are topology, not compliance.
Ephemeral rectangle over visible SVG node geometry, used only to view a subset. Creates no source group or worker action.
Supplier/Input/Process/Output/Customer rows rendered as selectable process swimlanes joining existing source-owned DAG nodes.
Declared source edges classified TRIGGER, RETRIGGER, DEPENDENCY and FEDERATION. No workflow dispatch without authenticated native scheduler action.
Machine-readable flowchart projection sharing node and edge IDs with HTML and SVG; not a separate canonical SSOT or runtime.
Historical measured points are connected only where comparable; future unknown remains unplotted and cannot imply numerical trajectory.
One canonical source identity can have multiple named placements and typed touch relationships across planar DAGs. Touches are not causal roots or proofs.
Count of source-described node placements or duplicate identity mappings, distinct from source-bound acceptance or executed tests.
The eligible population supporting a group-scoped metric (e.g. six-repo cells, authenticated pairs, kernel statements). Incompatible populations cannot be summed.
